names.en: Heaven and earth luck true inheritance
aliases: Giant Sun's heaven and earth luck true inheritance Longevity Heaven's luck path true inheritance of Giant Sun

summary.text: Heaven and earth luck true inheritance is one of Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's three luck path true inheritances. Lang Ya land spirit places it in Longevity Heaven.

claims.text: Lang Ya land spirit offers Fang Yuan a one-to-one trade of three true inheritances against Luo Po Valley, Dang Hun Mountain, and wisdom Gu; among Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s luck path true inheritances, only self luck is with Lang Ya to trade.

Heaven Extremity says self luck replenishes oneself, all living being’s luck takes others’ surpluses to replenish oneself, and heaven and earth luck takes heaven and earth’s surpluses to replenish oneself. Heaven and earth luck was created in Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s later years, grand and deep, deciphering the mysteries of heaven and earth. In that section, luck path turns calamities and tribulations into fortuitous encounters. Five Elements Grandmaster had heard that Giant Sun created self luck, stalled, then gained inspiration from The Legends of Ren Zu to create all living being’s luck before ascending as Immortal Venerable and later creating heaven and earth luck.

Five Elements Grandmaster sneaks into Longevity Heaven to steal the heaven and earth luck true inheritance after stalling in his own advancement, then ends trapped at the center of Calamity Luck Altar under the Eight Extremities. Heaven Extremity links Calamity Luck Altar’s reversal of calamity and luck to the profundity of heaven and earth luck.

South Desolation Immortal tells Yao Huang that Luck Suppression Heavenly Palace is a rank eight Immortal Gu House Giant Sun created personally using the heaven and earth luck true inheritance, and that it has suppressed its station for three hundred thousand years. He explains that life forms have luck, that rocks and rivers have luck, and that heaven and earth have heaven luck and earth luck, and that the heaven and earth luck true inheritance deciphers the profundities of heaven and earth, researching them, using them, and changing them.

South Desolation Immortal later says that after three hundred thousand years on station, the palace has deeply affected immemorial black heaven and even influenced immemorial white heaven, calling that the supreme power of heaven and earth luck.
Self luck sits in Lang Ya blessed land, all living being’s luck in Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, and heaven and earth luck in Longevity Heaven.
The only force excelling in luck path is Longevity Heaven. Giant Sun Immortal Venerable never joined Heavenly Court, and he never passed his luck path true inheritance to Heavenly Court.

There are only three luck path true inheritances, arranged well by Giant Sun Immortal Venerable, and they did not become widespread in the world. Heavenly Court was searching hard for them without any gains.

Fang Yuan judges that Cooking Luck Pot is weak in offense and strong in defending luck, and that luck path offensive methods are mostly in the true inheritances of all living beings luck and heaven and earth luck.

During limited cooperation with Longevity Heaven, Fang Yuan suggested exchanging venerable true inheritances of equal value for Longevity Heaven’s luck path true inheritance of Giant Sun. Bing Sai Chuan rejected him politely, but his attitude was firm. Fang Yuan also asked to exchange immortal materials for rank nine luck path immortal materials, and Bing Sai Chuan rejected that as well. Longevity Heaven would not make that transaction, because it would help Fang Yuan’s growth.
